scientific_object: paired online experience-learning policy trajectory on identical ordered real streams

canonicalization.terminator: exactly one LF after the canonical JSON object
canonicalization.digest: lowercase SHA-256 hex over canonical bytes
canonicalization.self_digest: manifest_sha256 is omitted before hashing; all other keys remain unchanged
canonicalization.path_encoding: POSIX UTF-8 relative paths; no absolute paths, dot segments, symlinks, or duplicate entries

estimand.name: paired cumulative pre-update loss difference
estimand.unit: fresh independent assessment seed and ordered stream trajectory
estimand.fit_tune_assessment: disjoint source identities and seed identities; assessment configuration is locked before effects
estimand.no_reuse: Phase836, V6, plasticity-guard, and Astral scientific artifacts are not inputs

provider_contract.hard_budget: hard_usd_ceiling is a positive user-supplied finite decimal; quoted_rate*max_runtime_minutes <= estimated_max_total_usd <= hard_usd_ceiling
provider_contract.credential_rule: credentials and tokens are never serialized in repository or receipts
provider_contract.cost_receipt: allocation receipt binds quoted rate, maximum minutes, ceiling, provider project, node ID, job ID, and launch manifest digest
provider_contract.stop_receipt: stop receipt binds allocation receipt, billed minutes, billed USD, terminal trigger, raw provider receipt digest, and launch manifest digest

launch_manifest.review_binding: protocol, packet, freeze manifest, and signed independent ACCEPT receipt must be digest-bound before launch

result_root.root_binding: result_root_manifest lists every payload path, byte length, and SHA-256 digest; validator rejects any actual path not listed
result_root.result_binding: aggregate_result binds campaign, launch, qualification, provider allocation, provider stop, energy, and root manifest digests

energy_contract.raw_trace: retained outside the repository with a SHA-256 digest, sample count, declared hardware path, and start/end timestamps
energy_contract.integration: finite nonnegative power samples, monotonic timestamps, trapezoidal joule integration or hardware energy counter explicitly declared
energy_contract.receipt_binding: energy receipt binds launch manifest, provider job, node ID, raw trace, and aggregate result

publication_gate.quality: paired loss improvement and adaptation improvement versus fixed SGD on at least two real families
publication_gate.resource: non-inferior active updates, storage bytes, latency, and event operations
publication_gate.statistics: predeclared seeds, paired tests, confidence intervals, and Holm correction; no post-hoc seed or endpoint selection
publication_gate.custody: all source, code, container, campaign, launch, provider, result-root, transcript, and energy digests validate
publication_gate.energy: measured receipt validates; proxy or absent energy fails
publication_gate.failure: any failed gate closes the identity as no_candidate without retuning

stop_rules: reject before review receipt is an independent signed ACCEPT
reject if any frozen byte digest changes
reject if hard USD ceiling is absent, nonfinite, or exceeded
stop on first provider, custody, runtime, qualification, or validator failure
stop at timeout or budget boundary
reject any result root with an extra file, directory, or symlink
reject any missing, proxy, stale, or unbound energy receipt
retain no_candidate unless every publication gate passes

boundaries.provider: not_authorized_until independent ACCEPT and operator spend ceiling
boundaries.h100: one bounded batch job only after no-spend preflight
